name: io.github.tempatsimpanku-pixel/genieacs-mcp
title: genieacs-nbi-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for GenieACS (TR-069) NBI: inspect CPE/ONT devices, faults and tasks.

environmentVariables.name: GENIEACS_NBI_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the GenieACS NBI, e.g. http://acs.example.net:7557

environmentVariables.name: GENIEACS_NBI_USER
environmentVariables.description: HTTP basic user, only if the NBI is behind auth.

environmentVariables.name: GENIEACS_NBI_PASS
environmentVariables.description: HTTP basic password, only if the NBI is behind auth.
